card.name: Joints inside names and compounds
card.fires_on: Punctuation or short linking pieces that sit inside a longer name, such as a comma after 'child', a hyphen inside a place or Sanskrit title, or a split in a brand name like TRADJENTA or NURTEC ODT.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: A piece partway through an all-caps drug brand name.
modes.example: Tell patients to report development of blisters or erosions while receiving TRAD<<J>>ENTA.

modes.label: Hyphens in compound names
modes.description: A hyphen joining parts of a place or title.

modes.label: Linking words and commas
modes.description: A comma or small word like 'of' or 'or' in the middle of a sentence, before a name or noun is expected.
modes.example: is a city in and the county seat<< of>> Kendall County, Texas, United States,

card.plain: It fires at the joints inside names and compound terms, where the next piece is still to come.
